boards.name: ESP-Mosaico
boards.blurb: 480×480 touch screen. Walking pet: steps, camera slot, interaction module.
boards.note: Writes only PixelMate's app slot and the partition table, like the Mosaico system update. The launcher, recovery and system data stay as they are.
connect: Plug the ESP-Mosaico into this computer with a USB-C data cable.
Click Connect and pick the port that appears when you plug it in.
If no port appears or it won't connect, put the board in download mode (see the ESP-Mosaico guide) and try again.
boards.after: The board restarts into PixelMate. If it stays on the launcher, open PixelMate from it.

boards.name: M5Stack StackChan
boards.blurb: CoreS3 head, 320×240 touch screen. Desk pet with a neck and a camera.
boards.note: Replaces the firmware on the CoreS3. The first install overwrites the factory firmware, so back it up first if you may want it back.
connect: Plug the StackChan's head (the CoreS3) into this computer with a USB-C data cable.
Click Connect and pick the port named USB JTAG/serial debug unit.
If it won't connect, hold the reset button on the side for about 3 seconds until the green LED lights, then try again.
boards.after: The CoreS3 restarts into PixelMate. If the screen stays dark, press the reset button once.

boards.name: M5Stack StopWatch
boards.blurb: Round touch screen. Walking pet: steps, clock, pocket mode.
boards.note: Replaces the firmware on the StopWatch. The first install overwrites the factory firmware, so back it up first if you may want it back.
connect: Plug the StopWatch into this computer with a USB-C data cable.
Click Connect and pick the port named USB JTAG/serial debug unit.
If it is asleep, press the yellow key (KEYA) to wake it, then try again.
boards.after: The StopWatch restarts into PixelMate. If the screen stays dark, press the yellow key.
